protocol.cv: RepeatedStratifiedKFold(5 splits x 5 repeats, seed 0) = 25 folds
protocol.inner_tuning: StratifiedKFold(3) GridSearchCV on each outer training fold, scoring=roc_auc
protocol.leakage_control: cleaning, imputation, scaling, screening, attribution and verification are all fitted inside the training fold only
protocol.paired: per-fold difference, same train/test indices for every arm

chronological.rule: train on the earliest 70% of wafers by timestamp, test on the last 30%

rolling_origin.rule: 5 contiguous time blocks; train on blocks 0..k, test on block k+1, for k = 0..3

logreg_all.label: logistic regression, all sensors (C tuned inner-CV)

hgb_all.label: hist gradient boosting, all sensors (tuned inner-CV)

agent_rf.label: agent loop (RF probe + RF on survivors)

agent_logreg.label: agent loop (logistic probe + logistic on survivors)
